name: Buried Crate
text: A sealed crate sits half-sunk in cooled slag. The lid is rusted shut, but the seams look weak.

choices.label: Pry it open
choices.text: Take 6 damage. Gain a random Refined part.

name: The Hungry Servitor
text: A small servitor with a cracked furnace-belly tugs at your plating, begging for parts.

choices.label: Feed it a part from Cargo
choices.text: Refined or better: gain a random Blueprint. Otherwise: gain 25 Aether.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.text: It whirs sadly and wanders off.

name: The Conveyor Lottery
text: Parts roll past on a still-running belt. You could swap one of yours for whatever comes next.

choices.label: Swap a part from Cargo
choices.text: 50%: a random part one tier higher. 50%: one tier lower.

name: Rogue Workbench
text: A damaged Workbench sparks and hisses. Its clamps still move.

choices.label: Use it
choices.text: Take 5 damage. A Workbench visit with 1 Tool Charge.
